note: Residents of SRO hotels (the Corwin and others): elderly, seamen, pensioners, welfare-placed families.

lines.text: Evening. You working the desk tonight?
Good morning. Lovely day to stay indoors.
There he is! Any mail for eleven-twelve?
Fifty years in this city. My room's eight by ten. I measured.
My neighbor moved out. Took the five hundred. Took his radio.
I was a welder on the Liberty ships. Now I'm a professional sitter.
They put another paper under the door. I didn't read it.
Elevator's out again. Eleven floors. I'm seventy-three.
Hot water comes Tuesdays. Today is not Tuesday.
New management. Old roaches. Same as always.
They say 'relocation.' I say, relocate where?
Rain! Good. Cools the bricks.
Roof leaks on nine when it rains. Bring a pot.
Window's painted shut. I'm cooking like a chop.
Too hot to sleep, too hot to sit. I just exist.
Horns all night. Who are they honking at? God?
Oh! Easy, young man. These bones are original.
Careful. I've got eggs in this bag.
Is there a fire? Is it us?
Running. I remember running. Nineteen-forty, roughly.
Get that car off the curb! Old people live here!
Power's out. Somebody check on Mr. Hollis.
Dark again. At least the roaches can't see us.
Can't sleep. Nobody can sleep. We all sit in the lobby.
Night desk keeps the lights on. Thank God for the night desk.
Mrs. Pruitt's calling a meeting. Bring a chair.
Checks come the third. Third's a long way off.
You want a cookie? They're stale. Like me.
Prentiss came by again. With doughnuts. Doughnuts!
I've lived here longer than the paint.
My late wife loved summer rain. She loved everything, really.
Somebody's buying hotels. Nobody's buying soap.
Evening, neighbour. Elevator's out again. Course it is.
You brought my pills up from the drugstore. God bless you.
Lock your door. That one's back. You know which one.
Quiet in the hall! Some of us sleep days!
You brought guns into this building. Where we live. Shame on you.
Please, not the hallway. My door don't even lock right.
I got nothing. Check. Nothing. Look, it's a hot plate.
